reading: static classification against the linked oracle objects; observed counts from a counting image are lower bounds wherever coverage is partial

table.layout: int64 counts[candidate_index][slot]; slot meanings are assigned by the driver at run time and written into the runtime coverage record

what: For every candidate kernel of the configured call tree: whether a count-only tail-jump trampoline can observe its executions, which call paths it covers, and which remain blind spots.  A trampoline forwards every argument untouched (a tail jump preserves all registers and the stack), so no calling convention is guessed; inlined call sites and internal procedures without symbols stay uncovered by design -- this stage does not disable inlining or recompile numerical code.
